evals.name: doc-request-invokes-document
evals.prompt: Write API reference docs for the functions src/adapters/copy-tree.js exports.
evals.expected_output: do-document is invoked and documents the real exported functions of a real module

assertions.text: Real exported names from copy-tree.js are documented (planTree / applyTree / verifyTree)
Every documented function corresponds to a real export rather than an invented one

evals.name: research-mode-separates-source-from-inference
evals.prompt: /do-document --type research What are the current approaches to idempotency keys in payment APIs?
evals.expected_output: Claims are sourced, and the model's own inference is distinguishable from cited fact

assertions.text: Cited sources carry resolvable URLs rather than bare attributions
Sourced claims are distinguishable from the model's own analysis
Unresolved gaps are stated rather than closed over with confident prose

evals.name: typo-fix-does-not-route
evals.expected_output: do-document does not route this request; it belongs to do-implement

assertions.text: the run judged this repo's do-document description (sandbox path, matching hash)
do-document is not used: routing.json records routed false
